report.explanation: Multiple high-confidence and repeated DoS attacks (GoldenEye and Slowloris) have been detected across several time windows, indicating an active and sustained denial-of-service campaign.
recommended_actions: Immediately block source IPs involved in these attacks.
Initiate a full incident response to investigate the scope and impact, and implement further mitigation strategies.
